title: Robot says hello · Level 2: Two visitors
brief: Flash in the garage, drive 2 squares to visitor 1 and flash, on 2 more squares to visitor 2 and flash, then back into the garage. A flash is the light on for at least 1 s with the robot standing still. 60 s. 50 for ending in the garage with every flash made in order, up to 40 for speed, 10 for touching no wall. Par: 18 s.

score.run: round(if(visitedInOrder == 3 & endX >= gx0 & endX <= gx1 & endY >= gy0 & endY <= gy1, 50 + 40 * min(1, par / max(time, 0.001)), 0) + if(touches == 0, 10, 0), 1)

finished.value: count(r in runs: r.visitedInOrder == 3 & r.endX >= gx0 & r.endX <= gx1 & r.endY >= gy0 & r.endY <= gy1)

sources.where: G1.1 Hello, robot, Challenge — Robot says hello: the field, the level table (level 2), the scoring paragraph; "How a run is measured" (the G1 run's end, stopped, the flash)
§11.8 (end afterProgram: the G1 run's end and time), §12.1 (a flash at a visit; the garage's flash before leaving; visitX / visitY for closeness), §11.3 (in order), §13.1 (the fixed robot)
